sample_unit: LLM responses (315 expert ratings per outcome)

links.outcome: Head-to-head comparison of three LLMs on identical guideline-based JIA questions rated by blinded experts
links.effect: GPT-5.6 Sol scored highest: accuracy 4.71, usability 4.70, quality 6.47, vs Gemini 3.1 Pro (4.04, 4.24, 5.32) and Claude Opus 5 (3.93, 3.90, 5.26); all p<0.001.
links.quote: Contemporary LLMs differed meaningfully in guideline-based JIA performance, with differences varying by clinical task.

links.outcome: Accuracy and guideline concordance of LLM answers to JIA guideline questions rated by pediatric rheumatologists
links.effect: Accuracy means ranged from 4.71 (GPT-5.6 Sol) to 3.93 (Claude Opus 5) on a 5-point scale, with domain-dependent differences (LLM×domain p=0.005).
links.quote: GPT-5.6 Sol achieved the highest mean scores for accuracy (4.71 ± 0.47), usability (4.70 ± 0.55), and quality (6.47 ± 0.71), compared with Gemini 3.1 Pro (4.04 ± 0.95, 4.24 ± 0.86, 5.32 ± 1.11) and Claude Opus 5 (3.93 ± 0.89, 3.90 ± 0.81, 5.26 ± 1.05; all p < 0.001).

screen.reason: Expert evaluation and comparison of three commercial LLMs answering guideline-based questions regarding juvenile idiopathic arthritis without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
